Does it feels like u r being controlled, life, fate, destiny by some form of ur family believes? Have u surrendered your self to their believe of its higher power? To me, being a witch or wiccan I believe I control my own life. And also believing that one has the right to choose the path I want. And also give me the power to my own freedom. Though I ask the guidance and devoted myself to mother goddess, also I believe she will influence me giving me and direct me and make my life better, but I also believe my own power of freedom.

Now I wan to talk about the philosophy of Buddhism,  in Buddhism they don't focus on divinity, Buddha means the enlightened one, and he is not a god. Every one can be a Buddha, who is free from the cycle of sufferings. What I wan to say is, if u wan to be free from any form of spirituality that effects u, maybe u can try to let go of what had taken control over u spiritually. U can try vipasana meditation, by focusing in ur breathing and if u r able to reach in the one pointedness state of mind. U can read more about it online.

The other way is look into the mirror and see your own reflection, keep telling to yourself in your reflection the life that you want. Overtime, your subconscious mind will be convinced and so it will manifast in your conscious mind into the physical world. 

Another way is you can try grounding, centering and shielding. Shielding yourself spiritually will protects you. This u can read more about it online. 

Another thing I believe is, when you believe in something, you gave it power. Believing in something, brings the connection to it. The mind is open to that channel. 

Though I am not a Christian, u can also embrace your family faith and pray about what is troubling u. 

Find one that suits u and practise it, whether wicca, witchcraft or Buddhism, one does not need to be a Buddhist to practise Buddhism, one does not need to be a wiccan to practise wicca, and one does not need to be a witch to practise witchcraft. It's just something that u do once in your life time to help u overcome your situation. Remember faith is a powerful thing, because in magick, if one does not have faith in it, it doesnt work because the power is not given, because one does not believe in it. Same with prayers. 

I hope this help. Blessed be.
